name: Sotoo Tadanao
source:
"Listen closely, I'll only say this once. Don't you dare embarrass me."

He's the father of the Onigashira [url=/c44373]Kaki[/url], but his rank as an oni is the lowest.
Despite his low rank, he is an arrogant person with quite the attitude.
